name: Stagger Spires
design_intent:
STAGGER SPIRES — THE HIGH WIRE #9 (tier 2, four spires, moderate sawtooth). Four spire-tops over a starfield void alternate between two heights (y1020 / y620), separated by 600px gaps, with one central spring throne over the middle gap. A gentler introduction to the spires' extreme verticality: real up-and-over diagonal boosts between neighbours, but only a ~400px height swing (not the deep-spires 520). kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: the moderate sawtooth (Spires/deep_spires are the extreme version; the ridges are flat). Feel = 'hop the staggered pillars on short diagonal boosts, climb for the throne.'

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 600px in ~0.9s @ ~24 fuel; super 2800 clears all). Spires S1(0..480 top1020) S2(1080..1560 top620) S3(2160..2640 top1020) S4(3240..3720 top620); throne spring x1680..2040 top140:
- GAP S1<->S2 / S2<->S3 / S3<->S4: each = 600px horizontal AND ~400px vertical offset (a diagonal arc). 600 > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395 (trampoline). NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED on every crossing; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top y140): 480px above the low spires (S2/S4 top620), over the open S2<->S3 gap. Trampoline apex 270 from S2 reaches only y350 -> short; an under-shot drops into the void. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER). (Rule B, >= 480.)
- RECOVER: low spire bottom 1076 -> bottom blast line 1976 = 900px of open sky (>= 650, Rule D) -> a fuelled knock-off boosts back to a spire. Verb: FLY.
- Because every horizontal gap (600px) already exceeds the 527px max spring drift, no spire's neighbour is bounce-reachable regardless of the height offset; the jetpack is required to move at all. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.
